title: Zimbabwe's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) Country Statement, 2025-2035
organization: Government of Zimbabwe, Ministry of Environment, Climate and Wildlife
geographic_coverage: communities dependent on climate-sensitive natural resources
temporal_coverage: Reported drought seasons from 2012 to 2024 and climate-hazard outlook, in a 2025 NDC
methodology: NDC summarizes national hazard trends and adaptation priorities drawn from the NAP.

title: Zimbabwe Economic Update: Improving Resilience to Weather Shocks and Climate Change
temporal_coverage: National agriculture profile and 2023-2024 El Nino drought impacts, reported in January 2025
